data.name: Zero State
data.detailed_description:
Wake up in a bleak world of paranoia and oblivion. Faceless killers are hunting you. Your only chance to survive is to steal fragments of lives from the dead.

Memory Hack: Kill and temporarily absorb your victims' skills, memories, and emotions. Become a sharpshooter, a skilled hacker, or an invisible shadow—but not for long. Every stolen piece brings your mind closer to chaos, distorting reality with the voices and visions of past "donors."

Survive at any cost: Use unstable borrowed abilities in tactical encounters. Every decision—who to kill, what to take—is a balance between life and sanity.

Reassemble yourself from fragments: Seek the truth about "Project Zero State" and your own past within the shreds of others' memories and hidden clues of this grim world.

Choose your ending: Revenge, disappearance, or an attempt to forge a new "self" from the chaos of stolen lives. Will you remain a victim, a weapon, or become something else?

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere: Explore industrial ruins, urban slums, and underground labyrinths soaked in isolation and fear.

Memory Hack—your key to survival and your path to madness. Master a unique mechanic where every skill is a curse, and the truth might shatter the last remnants of your "self." Find a way out of Zero State.

data.short_description: Zero State – A tactical shooter where you play as "Null," a man with no memory. Steal the skills and memories of the fallen to survive—but each theft brings you closer to madness. Survive by balancing power and sanity!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X или Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 (8 ГБ) или NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (8 ГБ)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X или Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 ГБ) или NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 ГБ)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
